svg.title: CAP Platform Architecture on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Production architecture diagram for the Coding Assessment Platform deployed on Google Cloud with Cloud Run services, Cloud Run jobs, a worker pool, Artifact Registry, Secret Manager, VPC connector, PostgreSQL, Redis, Judge0 on GCE, Firebase, Groq, LangSmith, and Brevo.
svg.text: CAP Platform Architecture on Google Cloud
Production deployment view for Cloud Run, GCE Judge0, managed data, secrets, and external SaaS integrations

g.text: Public entry is Cloud Run frontend
